the CMB data are consistent with slow-roll inflation, that the spectral index of scalar perturbations can differ significantly from unity, and that the spectral index (and the amplitude) of gravitational waves can be nonnegligible.

the predictions of the slow-roll inflationary scenario for the CMB anisotropic power spectrum are different from the predictions of the power-law scenario, and that the space of parameters that can be constrained from the CMB data is larger than previously assumed.

(1) the power-law inflation model is not physically realistic; (2) the spectral index of gravitational waves is not negligible; and (3) the CMB multipolar moments are significantly different in the slow-roll and power-law scenarios.
